$comment: Hand-verified against vendor pricing pages. Every record carries sourceUrl and seenAt. Prices do NOT only move downward — Anthropic Sonnet 5 rises on 2026-09-01 — so a stale table is wrong in both directions. tokenizerInflation captures documented tokenizer changes: Claude 4.7+ emits ~30% more tokens for the same text than earlier Claude models, so counting them with a near-neighbour BPE alone under-counts the bill.

models.note: Cached input is 10% of input. Batch API is 50% off input and output.

Cache write is 1.25x input for a 5-minute entry and 2x ($10/MTok) for 1 hour; cache read is 0.1x. Anthropic publishes no browser tokenizer, and Claude 4.7+ uses a NEWER tokenizer that produces ~30% more tokens for the same text than earlier Claude models — so a near-neighbour BPE under-counts badly unless inflated. Enabling any tool adds a 290-token tool-use system prompt (410 with tool_choice any/tool). Minimum cacheable prefix is 1,024 tokens (2,048 is Opus 4.7, not 4.8). Changing tool definitions invalidates the tools, system AND message caches; changing tool_choice invalidates only messages.

INTRODUCTORY pricing through 2026-08-31; standard $3/$15 takes effect 2026-09-01, so this row is scheduled to become wrong. 1-hour cache write $4/MTok. Uses the newer Claude 4.7+ tokenizer (~30% more tokens for the same text). Enabling any tool adds a 354-token tool-use system prompt (474 with tool_choice any/tool). Minimum cacheable prefix 1,024 tokens.
Output price includes thinking tokens. Context caching also bills storage per hour whether or not the cache is reused — not modelled here. No public browser tokenizer.
Input rate shown is cache-miss. Cache hit is roughly 0.8% of miss — the most extreme cache economics of any provider here.
